operations.description: Lists all of the available billing REST API operations.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] operations list [PATH] providers microsoft billing operations [PARAMS] version [SCHEMA] list operation result

operations.description: Lists the available invoices for a subscription in reverse chronological order beginning with the most recent invoice. In preview, invoices are available via this API only for invoice periods which end December 1, 2016 or later
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] invoices list [PATH] subscriptions providers microsoft billing invoices [PARAMS] expand filter id skiptoken subscription top version [SCHEMA] invoice invoices list properties resource result

operations.description: Gets the most recent invoice. When getting a single invoice, the downloadUrl property is expanded automatically.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] invoices latest [PATH] subscriptions providers microsoft billing invoices latest [PARAMS] id subscription version [SCHEMA] download invoice properties resource url

operations.description: Gets a named invoice resource. When getting a single invoice, the downloadUrl property is expanded automatically.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] invoices [PATH] subscriptions providers microsoft billing invoices [PARAMS] id invoice name subscription version [SCHEMA] download invoice properties resource url
